summary: Sagimet Biosciences filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing a September 30, 2026 underwriting agreement with Leerink, TD Securities, and Guggenheim for a $115 million underwritten equity offering of 8,750,010 common shares at $10.00 and 2,750,010 pre-funded warrants at $9.9999. Net proceeds of $107.5 million fund a Phase 3 denifanstat acne trial and other pipeline work. Closing expected October 1, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Watch pricing pressure and warrant overhang.
